purpose: Documentation of fixed demonstration rules, not a runtime configuration file or a clinical standard.
header_order: Any order; exact names required; no missing, extra, or duplicate columns.

record_id.rule: Nonempty and unique; fictional committed IDs use SYN-*.
record_id.on_invalid: Retain and query; do not merge or drop.

age_years.rule: ASCII digits only; leading zeroes allowed; no automatic whitespace normalization.
age_years.on_invalid: Retain blank/invalid text and query; no imputation.

sex_code.on_invalid: Retain and query against the source owner's data dictionary.

lesion_value.rule: Finite and positive; decimal or scientific notation accepted by Python Decimal.
lesion_value.on_invalid: Retain and query; nonpositive, nonfinite, or unrepresentable cm conversions are not applied.

lesion_unit.conversion: Multiply a finite positive value by 10 exactly using decimal exponent shifting; log before/after and reason.
lesion_unit.on_invalid: Retain and query; do not guess the intended unit.

preservation.records: Retain every structurally valid source record.
preservation.source_row: Logical CSV record position, with the header at 1; not necessarily the physical text line number.
preservation.qa_events: Number of logged events; a record may have multiple events.
preservation.delivery: Stage all four files; recover previous outputs on ordinary publish errors; keep recovery files if rollback fails.
